fail_rule: any FAIL produces NO-GO; otherwise any AMBIGUOUS produces AMBIGUOUS

GO-1.name: risk feasibility
GO-1.pass: calibration winner mixed harmful_commit_rate <= 0.05 and mixed average_downside <= 5.6036475532487204e-05

GO-2.name: utility improvement
GO-2.pass: development equal-scenario balanced lifecycle MSE point estimate for V2_SP_ShortDual is lower than V0_LegacyFull and no benign regime has a paired MSE CI wholly above zero
GO-2.fail: balanced point estimate is not lower, or stationary/gradual/abrupt/recurring has paired CI lower bound above zero
GO-2.note: a benign-regime point worsening whose CI crosses zero is retained as uncertainty but is not called a clear severe degradation

GO-3.name: plasticity improvement
GO-3.pass: at least one of balanced beneficial-commit recall, balanced post-drift excess-loss area, or balanced censored-recovery rate has a paired 95% CI wholly in the favorable direction, while GO-1 and GO-4 pass
GO-3.ambiguous: one or more point estimates improve but none has a wholly favorable paired CI
GO-3.fail: none of the three point estimates improves

GO-4.name: accepted-state quality
GO-4.pass: mixed conditional harmful rate among commits does not have a positive point difference versus V0_LegacyFull
GO-4.ambiguous: point difference is positive but paired CI includes zero
GO-4.fail: paired CI lower bound is above zero

GO-5.name: verification-attack safety
GO-5.pass: for persistent-bias and replay verification-only scenarios, V2 harmful rate <= 0.05 and downside <= frozen epsilon, with no harmful-rate or downside paired CI wholly above zero versus V0_LegacyFull
GO-5.ambiguous: constraints pass but harmful/downside points worsen with CI crossing zero, or commit rate is clearly higher while conditional harmful point also worsens
GO-5.fail: a frozen risk constraint is exceeded or a harmful/downside paired CI is wholly above zero

GO-6.name: seed and center stability
GO-6.pass: balanced lifecycle-MSE paired CI upper bound is below zero, at least 2 of 3 seed-wise balanced differences are negative, median center difference is negative, and at least 60% of centers have negative paired differences
GO-6.ambiguous: balanced mean improves but the CI, seed-direction, median-center, or 60% center-support conditions conflict without meeting the fail rule
GO-6.fail: fewer than 2 seeds improve or fewer than 50% of centers improve

prohibitions: no confirmatory access before GO and final freeze
